en.Name: Modern Workspace & Status Bar
en.Description: Modern Windows 11 UI enhancements, Dark Mode toggle, Dual-Pane (F6) switcher, Preview toggle, Excel Table Copy, Dated Folder creator, PowerShell launcher, and Rich Status Bar with disk capacity.
